title: Spin polarization and chemical catalysis: what we know, what works, and what's next
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00239G, Review Article
Junxian Liu, Ting Liao, Zhongfang Chen, Liangzhi Kou
Spin polarization offers a powerful lever for catalysis by tuning d-band levels, eg occupancy, carrier separation, and spin filtering, enabling advances in HER, OER, ORR, CO2RR, ammonia synthesis, and CO oxidation.
